textbookBox.concept: A state has four features: a defined territory, a permanent population, a government and sovereignty. Without people there can be no state.

beats.en: A state has four features: a defined territory, a permanent population, a government and sovereignty. Without people there can be no state.
beats.speakEn: A state has four features: a defined territory, a permanent population, a government and sovereignty. Without people there can be no state.

beats.en: The Constitution makers used the words democratic and republic together. In a democracy the people choose their rulers. In a republic the head of state, the highest office, is elected and not hereditary.
